info.title: API.SH: Profesia.sk
info.description: The Profesia.sk API from API.SH: public Profesia.sk data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Job ads on Profesia.sk with the site's filters: keywords, filter values (place, region, work area, position, contract type, language, advertiser type: from `facets` or /profesia/v1/filters, combined with commas), company, posting age, minimum salary per month or hour, on-site/remote/hybrid and sort. Each ad: `id`, `url`, `title`, `company`, `company_id`, `company_slug`, `location`, `salary` (text and parsed min, max, currency, period), `labels`, `posted`, `logo`. `facets` lists every filter value of the result with its count: pass `filter` back as `filter` (added to the ones you already have) or `params` as query parameters. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/profesia-search

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter values, comma separated (e.g. `bratislavsky-kraj,plny-uvazok`), from `facets[*].filter` or /profesia/v1/filters.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Only this company's ads (id from results or /profesia/v1/companies).

parameters.name: posted_within
parameters.description: Posted in the last 1, 2, 7 or 31 days.

parameters.name: remote_work
parameters.description: On-site only, home only, or partly from home.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
